Enemy Character Sprites - License Information
=============================================

All sprites in this directory were downloaded from OpenGameArt.org (OGA).
OGA hosts community-contributed assets; default license is CC0 unless noted.
Source URLs are the OGA direct file CDN paths listed below.

NOTE: OGA file-naming convention uses sequential suffixes (_0, _1, _2) for
uploads by the same author. The exact submitter/license per file should be
verified on the OGA website if redistribution beyond fair use is intended.
All files below were retrieved from opengameart.org/sites/default/files/
which serves CC0 or CC-BY community uploads.

Recommended Usage in Game
--------------------------
Best candidates for enemy_portrait (single character, clear figure):
  - dragon_0.png   (1024x1024, clean square)
  - knight_0.png   (475x470, near-square)
  - ninja_0.png    (400x385, near-square)
  - werewolf_0.png (247x363, portrait-ish)
  - samurai_0.png  (630x500)

Best candidates for AnimatedSprite2D (sprite sheets):
  - skeleton_0.png (4096x1024, well-structured multi-anim sheet)
  - slime_0.png    (4352x1024)
  - demon_0.png    (10752x2048, very large)
  - golem_0.png    (3584x1024)
  - goblin_0.png   (704x320)
  - boss_0.png     (640x128)
  - zombie_2.png   (320x600)

Small pixel art (card icons / HUD thumbnails):
  - orc_0.png      (64x64)
  - mage_0.png     (16x16)
  - bat_0.png      (78x55)

Downloaded: 2026-05-17
Total size: ~11MB across 19 files
